theme: A light day by design while Mike recovers.
greeting: The errands are behind you and the drive to Rockland is the day's last fixed point, Dan. With the girls in Florida and Mike taking it easy after surgery, the rest of the afternoon is yours to keep soft.

needsAttention.title: Lock in Sunday's NYC dinner
needsAttention.detail: Your Board has this as a p1 for today: a two-top for Sunday the 23rd. A table for two at 48 hours is an easy ask if you call directly and take the bar.

needsAttention.title: Amra wants to meet in New York
needsAttention.detail: In your BlackRock thread she wrote she'll be in NYC Sep 5-11 and would love to catch up in person; no reply has gone back yet.

needsAttention.title: Croatia gear order is stuck
needsAttention.detail: The order can't check out until Mike sends his sizes and boat-shoe picks, still open on your Board with the Sep 12 course closing in.

schedule.title: Keep the day clear
schedule.detail: Mike recovering from oral surgery - soft food, ice, keep it light.

flagged.title: Valoris opportunities follow-up
flagged.detail: Davit circulated the country-level opportunities from last week's brainstorm - worth a read before the Aug 27 call with Martin.

flagged.title: Two Head of Policy openings
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced Head of Policy roles at Stedi and Chainalysis this week.

flagged.title: MaineHealth estimate updated
flagged.detail: The estimate for your Sep 3 visit changed after an insurance-benefit update.

inbox.noise: The usual drift: a political fundraiser, a BBYO reunion evite, two Google family-group notes, and your own Japanese lesson.
inbox.clear: Everything else in the inbox is already handled.

resolved.title: Sailing textbooks sorted
resolved.detail: You sent the St. Pete address; Amy flagged your order for priority dispatch and sent ebook links to start now.

resolved.title: Valoris call is set
resolved.detail: Confirmed with Martin for Thu Aug 27, 12:00 ET / 18:00 CET; the Teams invite is on your calendar.

resolved.title: Mike's files printed
resolved.detail: He asked this afternoon and you replied that they were done and printed.

recipe.title: Roast Sugar-Sprinkled Peaches
recipe.why: High summer is peak stone-fruit season, when peaches are ripe enough to caramelize with barely any help.

acts.line: Juliano came by and the clothes went in the mail before noon.
The drive to Rockland is the one fixed point; after that the day stays deliberately gentle.
Nothing scheduled past the ferry - a soft-food supper and an early, quiet close.
